buffer.doc: The buffer class — available via `require` — is a fast intermediate storage for incrementally-constructed strings.

cat.doc: The CaT module is available via `require "pluto:cat"` and provides encoding and decoding for [the Colons and Tabs format](https://docs.soup.do/user/cat).

coroutine.doc: This page documents the changes & additions to the `coroutine` library in Pluto, which is built on top of Lua 5.5's.

io.doc: This page documents the changes & additions to the `io` library in Pluto, which is built on top of Lua 5.5's.

math.doc: This page documents the changes & additions to the `math` library in Pluto, which is built on top of Lua 5.5's.

os.doc: This page documents the changes & additions to the `os` library in Pluto, which is built on top of Lua 5.5's.

regex.doc: The Regex module is available via `require "pluto:regex"` and provides [Soup's flavor](https://github.com/calamity-inc/Soup/blob/senpai/docs/user/regex.md) of the popular string matching language.

scheduler.doc: The scheduler class — available via `require` — can be used to easily set up coroutine-based cooperative multitasking.

socket.doc: Must be included via `require`. This library is not available in WASM builds of Pluto.

string.doc: This page documents the `string` library in Pluto, which is built on top of Lua 5.5's.

table.doc: This page documents the changes & additions to the `table` library in Pluto, which is built on top of Lua 5.5's.

utf8.doc: This page documents the `utf8` library in Pluto, which is built on top of Lua 5.5's.

functions.name: scheduler.add
functions.doc: The `add` method can be used to turn a function into a coroutine. The coroutine is resumed once, added to the scheduler, and returned.

functions.name: scheduler.run
functions.doc: The `run` method activates the scheduler. The scheduler resumes all coroutines and then calls its yieldfunc until either all coroutines are finished, or a coroutine throws an error — in which case it is rethrown.

functions.name: scheduler.yieldfunc

functions.name: scheduler.errorfunc
functions.doc: `errorfunc` is a property on the scheduler that can optionally be set to customize how the scheduler reports errors in its coroutines. By default, this is `nil`, in which case any coroutine errors are rethrown (via `coroutine.xresume`).

functions.doc: Returns a new Vector3 instance that is a unit vector equivalent.

functions.name: vector3.torot
functions.doc: Returns a rotation vector based on the direction given by the current vector.

functions.name: vector3.lookat
functions.doc: Returns a rotation vector based on the position given by the current vector and argument.

functions.name: vector3.todir
functions.doc: Returns a direction vector based on the rotation given by the current vector.

functions.name: wasm.instantiate
functions.doc: Instantiates a WASM module.

functions.name: wasm.describe
functions.doc: Lists imports and exports of a WASM module.
functions.returns: A table with the keys "imports" and "exports", the values of which will be array tables, themselves containing tables with "name" and "kind" properties. "kind" will be "function", "global", "table" or "memory".

functions.name: wasm.global.new
functions.doc: Creates a WASM global which can be imported by one or more WASM module instance.

params.name: arg?
params.doc: The type of the global. Can be `i32`, `i64`, `f32`, `f64`, or `externref`, with an optional `mut` prefix.

params.name: value?
params.doc: The initial value of the global. Defaults to 0/null.

functions.name: wasm.table.new
functions.doc: Creates a WASM table which can be imported by one or more WASM module instance.

params.name: arg
params.doc: The element type. Can be `funcref` or `externref`.

params.name: n
params.doc: The initial size of the table.

params.name: limit?
params.doc: The maximum size of the table. Defaults to 0x10000.

params.name: t?
params.doc: Whether the table is 64-bit. Defaults to false. Note that 32-bit builds of Pluto don't support the memory64 proposal.

functions.name: wasm.memory.new
functions.doc: Creates a WASM memory which can be imported by one or more WASM module instance.

params.name: n
params.doc: The initial size of the memory, in pages (1 page = 0x10000 bytes).

params.name: limit?
params.doc: The maximum size of the memory, in pages. Defaults to 0x10000.

params.name: flag?
params.doc: Whether the memory is 64-bit. Defaults to false. Note that 32-bit builds of Pluto don't support the memory64 proposal.

functions.name: wasm.call
functions.doc: Calls the named exported function, with optional arguments following the name.

functions.name: wasm.write
functions.doc: Writes to the module's memory at the given offset with the given binary string.

functions.name: wasm.read
functions.doc: Reads from the module's memory at the given offset for the given amount of bytes and returns a binary string.

functions.name: xml.encode
functions.doc: Returns a string of XML.

params.name: data
params.doc: A table or string to encode as XML.

params.name: pretty?
params.doc: Whether to return a human-readable string of XML. Defaults to `false`.

functions.name: xml.decode
functions.doc: Returns a table representing the XML data.

params.name: parser
params.doc: Which parser to use against the data. Can be "html", "xml" (default), or "lax" (XML but accepts attributes without `=`).
